claim: Skeletal ligaments are defined as the dense connective tissue that spans the joint and then is fixed at both ends of the bone.

claim: One of the main functions of ligaments is mechanical, as they passively maintain joint stability and assist in guiding those joints through their normal range of motion when a tensile loading is applied.
source: One of the main functions of ligaments is mechanical, as they passively maintain joint stability and assist in guiding those joints through their normal range of motion when a tensile loading is applied (Frank, 2004).

claim: The anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) is crucial for knee kinematics, especially in rotation, and functions as an anterior/posterior stabilizer.
